name: copy-button
purpose: Icon-only control that copies a string to the clipboard and briefly confirms success. Composes `IconButton` for visuals and interaction tokens, and `Tooltip` for its name: an icon-only button is silent to a pointer user until hovered, so the glyph is always labelled on hover/focus. The tooltip text is the same string as the accessible name — `ariaLabel` while idle, `copiedLabel` for the two seconds after a write — so the confirmation is seen as well as announced. It is suppressed with `disabled`.
useWhen: Next to a value the user will paste elsewhere: an ID, a domain, a token, a CLI command.
Inside key/value rows, terminal mocks and code samples that need a one-click copy.
avoidWhen: The action is anything other than copying → use `icon-button`.
A labelled "Copy" action in a form or dialog footer → use `button`.
A full code sample with its own copy control → use `code-block`.
related: icon-button` — the control it composes; `kind` and `size` are forwarded to it.
tooltip` — composed to show `ariaLabel` and then `copiedLabel` on hover and focus.
code-block` — already embeds a copy-button for its content.
bestPractices: Pass the exact text in `value`; an empty `value` makes the click a no-op.
Localize `ariaLabel` and `copiedLabel`: each is both the accessible name and the tooltip text.
Listen to `copy` for analytics or a toast; it fires only after the clipboard write succeeds.
The click stops propagation, so it is safe inside clickable rows and cards.
Keep the `transparent` / `small` defaults in dense rows.

props.name: value
props.doc: Text copied to the clipboard on activation.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name while idle. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Copy`).

props.name: copiedLabel
props.doc: Accessible name while the copied state is shown. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Copied`).

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables interaction and applies disabled tokens.

events.name: copy
events.notes: Emitted after a successful clipboard write with the copied value.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CopyButton from '@aziontech/webkit/copy-button'
</script>

<template>
  <CopyButton
    value="https://example.com/deploy/abc123"
    ariaLabel="Copy URL"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Disabled
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CopyButton from '@aziontech/webkit/copy-button'
</script>

<template>
  <CopyButton
    value="https://example.com/deploy/abc123"
    ariaLabel="Copy URL"
    disabled
  />
</template>
